title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Tech-led, narrow rally; everything else dead. Nvidia's earnings and Salesforce's beat drove a mega-cap software melt-up while cyclicals, defensives, and small caps lagged. Breadth was poor: only XLK closed green, and equal-weight RSP fell 0.30%. The tape is a classic AI-earnings event, not broad risk appetite.

INDICES — VIX 14.5, below 20-day MA of 15.3. Ranking best to worst: SOXX +1.95%, QQQ +1.37%, SPY +0.66%, DIA +0.19%, IWM +0.29%. Large > small by 1.08pp. Oil USO +2.09% most notable cross-asset mover. SPY and QQQ both above 200-day MA.

VOLUME — SPY vol_ratio 0.81x, QQQ 0.81x — both below average, ignored. SOXX elevated at 1.1x with price up = accumulation in semis. IGV volume 2.2x with +7.74% = strong accumulation in software. Low SPY/QQQ volume on gains signals low-conviction breadth outside tech.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK Technology +3.16%, XLE Energy -0.22%, XLF Financials -0.65%, XLU Utilities -0.76%, XLB Materials -0.82%, XLI Industrials -0.85%, XLRE Real Estate -0.95%, XLC Comms -1.07%, XLY Discretionary -1.09%, XLV Healthcare -1.13%, XLP Staples -1.38%. Top industries: IGV +7.74%, CIBR +7.61%. Bottom: XRT -1.86%, XHB -1.40%. Money into software/security, out of retail and homebuilders. Rotation state: 'software catching up'.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR_vol 1.23, QQQ 1.12 — both elevated >1.0, protection demand. Skew positive at +2.7% SPY, +4.2% QQQ. SPY GEX flip 657.0 vs spot ~760 — price well above flip, dealer hedging amplifies upside. VIX 14.5 below 20-day = complacency despite put demand.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil +2.09% while JETS -1.38% — energy price spike not translating to airline profits. Silver +1.92% outpacing gold +0.30% on 20-day momentum, dollar flat 0.00%. No divergence transmission chains notable outside tech.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 45.4 Neutral. Movers: CRM +22.58% on Claudeforce guidance, PANW +12.83%, IGV +7.74%. CRM vol 4.7x with price up = accumulation. Worst momentum: XLU -0.76% 20d -3.31%. Watch: SLV +1.92% — silver vol 36.7% ATM, negative skew -6.3%, momentum extreme at +17.33% 20d; XLE -0.22% — 20d +5.65% fading with oil +2.09%; IWM +0.29% — RVX 18.4 below 20-day MA, small-cap vol compression.
